title: Korean Crispy Honeycomb Kimchi Dumplings
description:
Golden, crackling crust on the bottom, bursting with spicy kimchi and savory pork juice inside! Arranged in a viral honeycomb pattern, pan-fried, steamed to juicy perfection, and flipped in one crispy whole sheet. ✨

👩‍🍳 Ingredients:
- 20-22 Dumpling wrappers
- 300g Ground pork
- 200g Aged kimchi (squeezed bone-dry & finely chopped)
- Handful of fresh chives (chopped)
- 1/2 Green onion (chopped)
- 1 tbsp Minced garlic
- 0.5 tsp Grated ginger
- 1 tbsp Soy sauce
- 1 tbsp Oyster sauce
- 1 tbsp Korean chili flakes (Gochugaru)
- 1 tbsp Sesame oil
- 0.5 tbsp Sugar
- Black pepper to taste
- 1 tbsp Cooking oil + 1 tbsp Perilla oil (for pan)
- 120ml Water or beef bone broth (for steam)

🍶 Quick Steps:
1. Mix Filling: Combine pork, dried chopped kimchi, chives, scallions, and all seasoning in a bowl. Mix firmly in one direction until sticky and well bound.
2. Fold: Brush wrapper edges with water, add a spoonful of filling, and gather the top edges like a flower pouch, leaving the top slightly exposed.
3. Pack the Pan: Drizzle cooking oil and perilla oil in a cold skillet. Arrange dumplings tightly in concentric circles to form a seamless honeycomb wheel.
4. Pan-Fry & Steam: Cook over medium heat for 2 mins until the bottoms turn golden. Pour in 120ml broth and instantly cover with a lid. Steam over low heat for 10 mins.
5. Crisp & Flip: Remove the lid and cook for another 1-2 mins to evaporate residual moisture and crisp up the crust. Place a large plate on top, flip the pan with confidence, and serve hot!

title: Veal Stew with Vegetables 🥩#vealstew #stewrecipe #comfortfood #onepotmeal #homemadecooking
description:
Ingredients:
Veal fillet — 650 g
Carrot — 1
Onion — 1
Celery stalk — 1
Garlic — 2 cloves
Potatoes — 800 g
Broth — 400 ml
Tomato paste — 1 tbsp
Worcestershire sauce — 1 tbsp
Flour — for coating
Fresh thyme — 1 sprig
Bay leaf — 1
Sugar
Salt & pepper

Cut the veal into pieces, lightly coat in flour and sear until golden brown. Remove from the pot.

In the same pot, sauté the chopped onion, carrot, celery and garlic. Add the tomato paste and a little sugar, then cook for another minute.

Return the meat to the pot, pour in the broth and add Worcestershire sauce, thyme, bay leaf, salt and pepper.

Cover and simmer over low heat for 40 minutes.

Add the chopped potatoes and continue simmering for another 45 minutes, until the meat and potatoes are tender.

Estofado de Ternera con Verduras 🥩

Ingredientes:
Filete de ternera — 650 g
Zanahoria — 1
Cebolla — 1
Tallo de apio — 1
Ajo — 2 dientes
Patatas — 800 g
Caldo — 400 ml
Tomate concentrado — 1 cda
Salsa Worcestershire — 1 cda
Harina — para rebozar
Tomillo fresco — 1 ramita
Laurel — 1 hoja
Azúcar
Sal y pimienta

Corta la ternera en trozos, pásalos ligeramente por harina y dóralos en una olla. Retira la carne.

En la misma olla, sofríe la cebolla, la zanahoria, el apio y el ajo picados. Añade el tomate concentrado y un poco de azúcar, y cocina durante un minuto más.

Vuelve a incorporar la carne, vierte el caldo y añade la salsa Worcestershire, el tomillo, el laurel, sal y pimienta.

Tapa y cocina a fuego lento durante 40 minutos.

Añade las patatas cortadas y continúa cocinando durante otros 45 minutos, hasta que la carne y las patatas estén tiernas.

title: Take a deep breath. Experience the energy of the hydrogen breeze.
description:
On average, we all take 20,000 breaths every day. With each breath, we take around 500 ml of air into our lungs. We take air for granted, but we may not fully realise that in this increasingly polluted world, every breath contains substances that can threaten our health.

At Suhaku Space, we can now offer our clients a device which enables us to combat the noxious effects of pollution, in our own homes.

The Suhaku Home Hydrogen Generator uses a brand new system to administer high concentration hydrogen into the body, by combining it with air, and delivering it as a gentle breeze through a nozzle. This avoids the need for the use of a cannula, which is the system used by conventional hydrogen generators. However, for those who prefer to use a cannula, or to experience hydrogen therapy through goggles, both cannula and goggles can be bought separately and fitted instead of the nozzle.

The Suhaku Home Hydrogen Generator – made in Japan to the highest standards – is available to purchase from Suhaku Space in South Kensington (exclusive distributors in the UK).

title: You’ve seen the video, now the photo #photography #sonyalpha #longexposure #nightphotography
description:
You’ve seen the cinematic video… now here’s the photo 📸

Same location. Same phone box. Same night — but a completely different way of seeing the scene.

That’s one of the things I love about working across both photography and video. With video I’m thinking about movement, timing and how the scene unfolds. With photography, I’m looking for that one frame where the light, composition and moment all come together.

And sometimes a simple location is all you need.

A little light, a strong composition and a bit of creative vision can completely change an everyday scene.

title: 6 WEEKS of typing New Yorks most iconic view  | ASMR Art #art #satisfying
description:
There are easier ways to draw New York than carrying a vintage typewriter to the top of a skyscraper… ⌨️

For my latest artwork, I visited Edge NYC and set up my 1960s Olympia SM3 more than 1,100 feet above the streets of Manhattan.

From there, I began translating the view across New York towards Lower Manhattan into thousands of typewritten marks, building the skyline one keystroke at a time.

There is no pen, pencil or paint involved. Everything you see has been created using the characters of the typewriter, with coloured ribbons used to pick out selected details.

And somewhere amongst all those tiny marks, I have hidden a few surprises for you to find 

New York City, drawn entirely with a typewriter.

title: This Is What Happens in Your Brain When You Learn Something New 😳
description:
When you practice a new skill, brain cells physically reach out and grow new connections to store memories. 🧠⚡️

🧠 CONCEPT:
This is an example of neuroplasticity and synaptogenesis. The brain rewires its physical structure by growing new connections between living neurons.

🔬 HOW IT WORKS:
Neurons extend thin branches called axons and dendrites. When a connection is made, chemical signals form a synapse, allowing electrical pathways to carry information across the brain.

💡 WHY CONNECTIONS GROW:
Repeated practice strengthens these neural pathways through long-term potentiation, making skills easier, faster, and more automatic over time.

🎯 PURPOSE:
This video demonstrates how the brain physically changes its structure to adapt, learn, and retain new information.

📚 EDUCATIONAL NOTE:
Neuroplasticity occurs throughout your entire life, meaning your brain never stops physically reorganizing itself as you learn new skills or habits.

🎥 FOOTAGE SOURCE:
The original footage creator could not be reliably identified from the available source. I found this clip online and I do not claim ownership of the original clip.

⚠️ SAFETY:
Cognitive health and brain development depend on proper sleep, regular physical activity, and a balanced diet to support neurogenesis.

title: Clearest water in NZ! ✨
description:
Follow @sagarandami to save more spots for your next New Zealand trip! 🇳🇿👇

This was actually our third time visiting the Putāruru Blue Spring, and every single time we come here, it still blows us away. 💧✨

The water is so unreal clear it almost looks fake. We’ve traveled all over the country and haven't seen many places quite like this.

If you love spots like this, another place in NZ with crazy clear water is Te Waikoropupū Springs down near Abel Tasman / Golden Bay. Put both of these on your NZ hit list!

📍 Putāruru Blue Spring (Te Waihou Walkway)

description:
*Aishwarya Rai Bachchan as Longines Global Brand Ambassador*

Aishwarya Rai Bachchan has been associated with Swiss luxury watchmaker Longines since 1999, when she was appointed as their “Ambassador of Elegance”. This makes it one of her longest-running international endorsements, spanning over 25 years as of 2026. As Longines’ global face, she has featured in worldwide campaigns, events, and launches, embodying the brand’s values of elegance, tradition, and performance. Her partnership has been highly successful — a 2012 World Watch Report survey ranked her the world’s second-most-popular watch-brand ambassador. She has represented Longines alongside other global icons and continues to appear for the brand at major international events, including Cannes and Longines’ equestrian sponsorships. The association strengthened her image as a global style icon and remains one of the most enduring celebrity-luxury brand partnerships from India.

As the judge prepares to announce the winner, she remains just as composed—and when her hand is finally raised as the winner, she chooses to hug the very opponent who mocked her.

💡 Life Lesson: Not every provocation deserves a reaction. Sometimes the strongest response is to stay composed, let your actions speak, and refuse to carry someone else’s arrogance into your own character. Winning is powerful, but remaining graceful when you have every reason to retaliate is a deeper kind of strength.

🔥 Quote:
Silence Holds Fire...
While Ego Burns Higher.

Recipe👇🏽save this for later🍅

🇸🇪 Få 10 % rabatt på din beställning när du handlar för 1 000 kr eller mer med min kod: Dos10

🇺🇸Recipe👇🏽

Ingredients

* 7 fresh tomatoes
* 1 yellow onion, chopped
* 3 whole garlic cloves
* 2–3 tbsp olive oil
* 1 tbsp tomato paste
* 1 handful fresh spinach 
* 2 dl (just under 1 cup) heavy cream
* 2 dl grated parmesan cheese
* Salt, to taste
* Black pepper, to taste
* Paprika powder, to taste
* Fresh parsley, for garnish
* Pasta of choice

Instructions

1. Heat olive oil in a large frying pan.
2. Cut the tops off the tomatoes and place them cut-side down in the pan. Add the chopped onion and whole garlic cloves to the center of the pan.
3. Cover with a lid and cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes, until the tomatoes are soft.
4. Remove the tomato skins and discard them. Crush the tomatoes directly in the pan.
5. Stir in tomato paste and mix. 
6. Season with salt, black pepper, and paprika powder.
7. Stir in the spinach and cook until wilted.
8. Pour in the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer for a few minutes.
9. Meanwhile, cook your pasta according to the package instructions.
10. Add the cooked pasta to the sauce and toss until well coated.
11. Stir in the grated parmesan and mix until creamy and evenly combined.
12. Finish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.

title: Caramelized Onion Smash Burger Tacos You NEED to Try!
description:
Juicy smashed beef, crispy tortillas, melted cheddar, sweet caramelized onions, fresh lettuce, and a creamy homemade burger sauce — all in one seriously delicious taco! 🤤

The beef is pressed directly onto the tortilla, smashed beef-side down in a hot skillet until beautifully browned, then flipped and topped with cheddar. Cover until the cheese gets perfectly melty, then finish with those golden caramelized onions, lettuce, and plenty of burger sauce.

Ingredients:

500 g ground beef
4 flour tortillas
Salt & black pepper
1 tbsp olive oil
4 slices cheddar cheese
Shredded lettuce

Caramelized Onions:
2 large onions
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp butter
1 tsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt
Black pepper
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
2–3 tbsp water, as needed

Creamy Burger Sauce:
3 tbsp Greek yogurt
2 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp ketchup
1 tbsp mustard
2 tbsp finely chopped pickles
½ tsp smoked paprika
½ tsp sweet paprika
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp black pepper

Instructions: Caramelize the onions in olive oil and butter with brown sugar, salt, and pepper, adding a little water as needed. Finish with balsamic vinegar. Mix all the burger sauce ingredients until creamy. Press the ground beef thinly onto the tortillas and season. Cook beef-side down in a hot oiled skillet, pressing firmly, for 3–4 minutes. Flip, add cheddar, cover, and cook until melted. Top with caramelized onions, lettuce, and burger sauce. Enjoy! 🌮🔥

title: One-Pan Creamy Tomato Pasta 🍅🍝
description:
Ingredients

• 8 oz pappardelle nests / 225 g
• 10 oz cherry tomatoes, halved / 280 g
• 1 small red onion, thinly sliced
• 2 handfuls fresh spinach
• 6 garlic cloves, thinly sliced
• 6 oz tomato paste / 170 g
• 1 tsp dried oregano
• 1 tsp dried basil
• 1 tsp dried parsley
• ½ tsp chili flakes (optional)
• 1 tsp kosher salt
• 1 tsp black pepper
• Zest of 1 lemon
• 3 tbsp olive oil / 45 ml
• 1 cup heavy cream / 240 ml
• 2½ cups chicken broth / 600 ml

Toppings
• Fresh basil leaves, torn
• Grated Parmesan
• Protein of choice: grilled chicken, shrimp, or Italian sausage links

Instructions
1. Add the pappardelle nests, cherry tomatoes, red onion, spinach, and garlic to a large skillet. Sprinkle in the oregano, basil, parsley, chili flakes, salt, pepper, and lemon zest. Spread the tomato paste evenly over the top, then drizzle in the olive oil and pour in the heavy cream and chicken broth.
2. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, cover, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally so the pasta separates and cooks evenly and the tomato paste melts into the sauce.
3. Once the pasta is tender and the sauce has thickened, give everything a final mix.
4. Serve topped with fresh basil, grated Parmesan, or protein of your choice (grilled chicken, shrimp, or Italian sausage links are best).

title: Thatte Idli ✨️
description:
ingredients (Thatte Idli Batter):

3 cups parboiled rice
1 cup urad gota
2 tbsp sabudana
1/3 cup poha
2 tsp fenugreek seeds
Water (as needed, for grinding)
Salt to taste
Banana leaves (for lining)
Oil (for greasing)

Method:

• Wash rice and urad dal separately until water runs clear
• Add sabudana, poha, and fenugreek seeds to the dal
• Soak rice and dal separately for 6–8 hours
• Grind rice to a semi-fine texture (like fine semolina), adding water gradually
• Grind dal mixture to a smooth paste, adding water gradually
• Combine both batters and whisk to a flowing consistency
• Cover and ferment in a warm place until doubled or tripled in volume (8–15 hours depending on weather)
• Gently stir, add salt, and mix lightly
• Steam for 15–18 minutes on medium heat
• Cool slightly, demould, remove banana leaf, and serve hot

Podi (Gunpowder):

Chana dal 1/4 cup
Urad dal 1/2 cup
White sesame seeds 1/4 cup
Byadgi red chillies 10–12
Spicy dry red chillies 3 (optional)
Asafoetida 1 tsp
Salt to taste

Method:

• Dry roast chana dal and urad dal on low heat until fragrant
• Roast sesame seeds until lightly golden
• Roast chillies separately until crisp
• Cool everything completely
• Grind chillies first
• Add dals, sesame seeds, asafoetida, and salt
• Grind coarsely

Imagine This Being Your Top Speed While Being Chased #animals #shorts
description:
On Antarctic ice, the difference between a penguin and one of its major predators can look almost unfair. Adélie penguins have short legs and an upright body designed very differently from fast-running land animals.

Their real advantage begins once they enter the ocean. Penguins have evolved streamlined bodies and powerful flippers that effectively allow them to “fly” through the water, where they become dramatically faster and more agile.

Leopard seals are formidable Antarctic predators and penguins form part of their diet. Around the edges of sea ice, penguins therefore have to transition between 2 completely different environments — slow and vulnerable on land, but highly maneuverable underwater.

It’s an incredible example of evolution optimizing an animal for one environment rather than another.

description:
Before modern surgical thread and medical staples existed, indigenous cultures and ancient healers used nature’s most powerful clamps: Army Ants.

title: Zanjeerein drama best scene x edit #zanjeerain
description:
Zanjeerain (2026) is the latest collaboration between director Shahzad Kashmiri and writer Farhat Ishtiaq -the same celebrated duo behind Yaqeen Ka Safar, and produced by Momina Duraid. From the very first frame, it announces itself as something grander and more atmospheric than the average primetime serial. The story unfolds against the breathtaking backdrop of lush green mountains, weaving together a world where love, greed, and buried secrets collide. Everyone in this world is hiding something, some are imprisoned by old customs and inherited loyalties, others are consumed by hunger for power, and some are simply trying, desperately, to shield the people they love.
At the centre of it all is Rabia, played by Sajal Aly, a young woman who runs a modest dhaba with her brother, grounded and self-sufficient in a world that constantly threatens to swallow people like her whole. On the other side of the social divide is Sar Buland, played by Danyal Zafar, son of a prominent family embroiled in a bitter, long-running feud with their powerful rival, Zafran Khan. When Zafran's men attack their fields, the violence that follows ignites a vow of retaliation from Sherdil, played by Ahsan Khan -a man whose very name suggests the storm he carries within him. Dramanagar Beneath the conflict between these two families, locked in a grudge passed down through generations, is a younger generation quietly aching to break free. The love story at the drama's heart is tender and inevitable, but it blooms in soil soaked with injustice, feudal pride, and the suffocating weight of tradition.
It is Muddasir, played by Ameer Gilani -a friend who frequents the area -who falls for Rabia and the quiet world she has built around her little dhaba, with its organic garden and its unhurried rhythms.

One Small Mistake Got This Lion's Attention #animals #shorts
description:
A visitor standing near a fully grown male lion experienced a tense moment when a sudden sound caught the animal's attention. What began as an ordinary interaction quickly demonstrated why caution is essential around large predators.

Lions possess exceptionally sensitive hearing, allowing them to detect movements and sounds across their environment. Their ears can rotate independently to help pinpoint the direction of a noise, an important advantage when hunting or monitoring potential threats.

An adult male African lion can weigh between 150 and 250 kg, with powerful jaws, sharp claws and extraordinary muscular strength. Even lions accustomed to human presence retain their natural instincts and can react rapidly to unfamiliar movements or sounds.

When lions are feeding, additional caution is particularly important. Food-related competition and defensive behaviour can increase the risks of approaching them, which is why professional wildlife facilities use strict procedures and physical barriers during feeding.

Respecting a lion's space and following established safety rules helps protect both people and these magnificent predators.

title: Horror movies don’t make sense
Правильная подача узбекского плова
description:
Плов узбекский секрет мастерства. 1. Коронка из мяса (эстетика и вкус)
При варке самое вкусное (мясо, лук, морковь и чеснок) оседает на дно в соусе зирвак. Переворачивая казан, вы выкладываете это богатство сверху на горку риса – гости сразу видят главный ингредиент, а мясо не тонет в каше.

2. Сок идёт сверху вниз (пропитка)
В глубоком казане весь жир и сок скапливаются внизу, а верхний рис остаётся суховатым. Перевёрнутый плов заставляет горячие соки стекать через всю толщу риса, делая каждое зёрнышко ароматным и маслянистым.

3. Рис «дышит» (рассыпчатость)
В горячем казане рис продолжает париться и может превратиться в кашу из-за конденсата. На широком подносе (лягане) плов быстро остывает до нужной температуры, лишний пар уходит – и рис становится идеально рассыпчатым, не слипается.

4. Удобство сервировки
Казан тяжёлый, глубокий и обжигающе горячий (руки лезут внутрь). Широкий плоский поднос – это готовая сервировочная тарелка. На столе легко перемешивать плов ложкой, не обжигая запястья о стенки, и удобно раздавать порции.

5. Важный лайфхак – как правильно перевернуть
Перед переворотом дайте плову настояться под крышкой 5–7 минут. Затем резким движением переверните казан   Постучите по дну казана – и откроется идеальная золотистая корочка из мяса. Это магия узбекской кухни!

description:
Watch this beluga whale feeding session to see why trainers provide specialized water jelly for hydration.

We are looking at the specific biological challenge of captive marine mammals that cannot drink seawater. Because the whale relies on its diet for moisture and frozen fish lose water content during storage, trainers must supplement the diet with this gelatinous water source to ensure the animal remains properly hydrated.

Understanding these beluga whale care requirements reveals the level of attention needed to maintain healthy animals in human care. By observing how this water jelly is administered, we gain insight into the precise dietary management necessary for survival when natural sources are unavailable. These wildlife observations highlight the specialized protocols that animal trainers utilize to support the daily health of aquatic species.

title: Peter Parker’s Pain Levels 💔🕷️ | From Crying to Hiding His Pain Behind a Smile 😢
description:
💔 THREE LEVELS OF PAIN… AND EVERY LEVEL TELLS A DIFFERENT STORY. 🕷️

Peter Parker is one of the most relatable characters in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Behind the Spider-Man mask is a young man who experiences loss, disappointment, loneliness, and difficult moments while trying to keep moving forward. This emotional edit shows three different levels of pain through Peter Parker’s expressions, emotions, and changing personality. ❤️‍🩹

😢 PAIN LEVEL 1 — YOU WILL CRY

At this level, emotions are difficult to hide. Every memory, every disappointment, and every painful moment can feel overwhelming. Peter’s expression reminds us that even a superhero has moments when life becomes difficult. Sometimes, tears reflect how deeply someone cares.

🧊 PAIN LEVEL 2 — YOU STAY CALM IN EVERY SITUATION

At this level, a person may appear calm even when dealing with difficult circumstances. Instead of reacting immediately, they try to understand the situation and carry on. Peter has faced challenges that forced him to mature, make difficult choices, and become more responsible. Staying calm does not always mean that everything is okay.

🙂 PAIN LEVEL 3 — YOU JUST SMILE AND ACCEPT EVERYTHING

This is the most emotional part of the edit. Sometimes, a smile can hide feelings that others cannot see. Peter Parker has experienced moments that changed his life forever, yet he continues trying to do what he believes is right. His journey reminds us that accepting a difficult situation does not mean it never mattered. It means learning from the experience and finding the courage to move forward.

🕷️ WHY PETER PARKER’S STORY HURTS SO MUCH

What makes Spider-Man special is that he is not just a superhero who fights villains. He is someone who struggles with emotions, relationships, responsibility, and the consequences of his decisions. His journey teaches us that strength is not always about winning a fight. Sometimes, strength means being patient, asking for support, and continuing to grow through life’s challenges.

❤️‍🩹 Remember: You do not always have to pretend to be okay. Everyone experiences difficult days, and talking to someone you trust can make a difference.

description:
The Mirage is a family of jet aircraft designed by the French aerospace company Dassault Aviation. Known for their sleek design, advanced technology, and exceptional performance, Mirage aircraft have been a cornerstone of military aviation since the 1950s. The Mirage III, one of the earliest and most iconic models, played a pivotal role in the air forces of many countries. It was renowned for its delta-wing design, which provided excellent maneuverability and speed. Powered by a single-engine, the Mirage III could reach speeds exceeding Mach 2, making it one of the fastest jets of its time.

The Mirage family expanded with the Mirage 5, Mirage F1, and the highly advanced Mirage 2000. Each variant brought significant improvements in avionics, weapon systems, and versatility. The Mirage 2000, for instance, introduced fly-by-wire technology and advanced radar systems, making it a formidable multi-role fighter capable of air-to-air and air-to-ground missions. Its agility, coupled with state-of-the-art missiles and electronic warfare capabilities, ensured that the Mirage 2000 remained relevant in modern combat scenarios.

Mirage aircraft have seen action in numerous conflicts around the world, proving their combat effectiveness and reliability. They have been used by air forces in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and South America. Their ability to operate in various environments and their ease of maintenance have made them a favorite among pilots and ground crews alike.

The Mirage series represents a significant achievement in aviation history, showcasing the innovation and engineering prowess of Dassault Aviation. These aircraft have not only defended nations but also set benchmarks in aviation technology, influencing the design of future fighter jets. The Mirage legacy continues to be celebrated for its contribution to both military aviation and aeronautical engineering.

title: Showering Onboard Etihad A380 First Class Apartments at 38,000 feet
description:
Showering at 38,000 feet on Etihad A380 First Class Apartment

One of the most iconic features of the Etihad Airways Airbus A380 First Class Apartments is the onboard shower, and after takeoff, the crew offered to prepare it for me.

A few minutes later, I was escorted to one of the 2 shower suites onboard. One is reserved for The Residence, while the other is shared between the 9 First Class Apartments.

Inside, you’ll find premium ESPA toiletries, plush towels, and everything you need to freshen up during a long haul flight. You get around 5 minutes of hot water, which you can pause at any time, giving you more than enough time for a proper shower. I actually managed to enjoy 2 full showers and still had time remaining.

Afterwards, I changed into the incredibly comfortable Giorgio Armani pajamas before returning to my apartment, where the crew had already transformed it into a beautifully prepared bed.

It’s details like these that make the Etihad A380 First Class Apartments one of the most remarkable First Class experiences in commercial aviation.

Part 3 is where we’ll take a closer look at the full bed setup and sleeping experience.

The **Ducati Panigale V4 SP2** is a high-performance sportbike engineered by the Italian automaker Ducati, renowned for its precision, aerodynamics, and track-focused design. Built as the ultimate expression of the Panigale lineage, the V4 SP2 blends motorsport engineering with road-legal capability. With its naturally aspirated V4 engine, lightweight construction, and race-derived suspension, the V4 SP2 represents the pinnacle of Ducati’s pursuit of pure riding performance.

Powered by a 1,103 cc Desmosedici Stradale V4 engine capable of revving up to 13,000 rpm, the V4 SP2 delivers 215 horsepower and accelerates from 0 to 100 km/h in just 2.8 seconds. Paired with a lightning-fast 6-speed transmission with STM-EVO SBK dry clutch, it provides an incredibly responsive and precise riding experience. The bike’s compact layout ensures exceptional balance, while electronic suspension and active traction control maximize grip and stability at high speeds.

One of the most striking features of the V4 SP2 is its aerodynamic design. The massive carbon-fiber winglets, front fairing, and air ducts work together to generate massive amounts of downforce, keeping the bike glued to the tarmac even during extreme cornering. Every vent, duct, and curve is purpose-built to enhance performance — a true example of form following function.

Inside, the setup is stripped down to essentials. Lightweight carbon-fiber wheels, adjustable aluminum footpegs, and race-inspired digital controls remind riders that this is a machine born for the track. Despite its minimalism, the V4 SP2 still offers modern comforts like riding modes and smartphone connectivity, proving that performance and usability can coexist.

For those seeking even greater extremes, Ducati offers the Full Racing Kit, adding an Akrapovič titanium exhaust, open carbon clutch cover, and removal kits for mirrors and license plate. This package reduces weight and pushes the V4 SP2 closer to full race-bike territory.

The Ducati Panigale V4 SP2 stands as a symbol of engineering excellence — a machine that bridges the gap between road bike and race bike. It embodies Ducati’s relentless dedication to precision, speed, and riding purity. With its unmistakable sound, flawless handling, and breathtaking design, the V4 SP2 doesn’t just perform — it defines what performance truly means.

description:
The Mirage is a family of jet aircraft designed by the French aerospace company Dassault Aviation. Known for their sleek design, advanced technology, and exceptional performance, Mirage aircraft have been a cornerstone of military aviation since the 1950s. The Mirage III, one of the earliest and most iconic models, played a pivotal role in the air forces of many countries. It was renowned for its delta-wing design, which provided excellent maneuverability and speed. Powered by a single-engine, the Mirage III could reach speeds exceeding Mach 2, making it one of the fastest jets of its time.

The Mirage family expanded with the Mirage 5, Mirage F1, and the highly advanced Mirage 2000. Each variant brought significant improvements in avionics, weapon systems, and versatility. The Mirage 2000, for instance, introduced fly-by-wire technology and advanced radar systems, making it a formidable multi-role fighter capable of air-to-air and air-to-ground missions. Its agility, coupled with state-of-the-art missiles and electronic warfare capabilities, ensured that the Mirage 2000 remained relevant in modern combat scenarios.

Mirage aircraft have seen action in numerous conflicts around the world, proving their combat effectiveness and reliability. They have been used by air forces in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and South America. Their ability to operate in various environments and their ease of maintenance have made them a favorite among pilots and ground crews alike.

The Mirage series represents a significant achievement in aviation history, showcasing the innovation and engineering prowess of Dassault Aviation. These aircraft have not only defended nations but also set benchmarks in aviation technology, influencing the design of future fighter jets. The Mirage legacy continues to be celebrated for its contribution to both military aviation and aeronautical engineering.

POLICE INTERROGATION TRICKS | 10 Psychological Tactics Used During Questioning | Psychology Facts | Rajnishmotivationalline

🧠 Have you ever wondered how police interrogators ask questions, use silence, and observe people's reactions to gather information?

Police questioning can involve different communication and psychological techniques. From strategic pauses to friendly conversation, certain approaches may influence how comfortable people feel and how much they choose to say.

In this video, we explore 10 psychological tactics that may be used during police interrogations and explain how silence, social pressure, and communication can affect human behavior.

Watch until the end to discover how these techniques work and why understanding psychology can help you become more aware of conversations and questioning situations. 👀

🕵️ 10 Police Interrogation Tactics

1. The Power of Silence 🤫
Long pauses can make people uncomfortable and encourage them to keep talking.

2. Acting Friendly 🤝
A relaxed and friendly approach may help an interrogator build rapport.

3. Claiming to Have Evidence 🔍
An interrogator may suggest that evidence exists to encourage a person to respond. Such claims are not necessarily proof that the evidence exists.

4. Mirroring Body Language 🧠
Matching someone's tone or gestures can sometimes make an interaction feel more familiar.

5. Using the Word "We" 💬
Inclusive language can create a sense of cooperation or shared purpose.

6. Repeating Your Exact Words 🔄
Repeating a statement can encourage clarification and help identify inconsistencies.

7. Showing Sympathy ❤️
Expressions of understanding may encourage someone to share personal information.

8. Acting Casual 😌
A relaxed manner may make a conversation feel less formal and lower a person's sense of pressure.

9. Strategic Pauses ⏳
Silence after an answer can encourage someone to elaborate or reconsider what they said.

10. Observing Reactions 👀
Interrogators may pay attention to changes in tone, wording, and behavior, although these reactions alone cannot reliably establish whether someone is lying.

💡 Important Psychology Lesson

Understanding these tactics can help you become more aware of how conversations influence your decisions.

However, no single behavior, facial expression, pause, or body-language cue reliably proves that someone is lying. Interrogation practices and legal protections also vary by jurisdiction.

If you are questioned by police in a real legal matter, consider seeking advice from a qualified lawyer rather than relying on social-media psychology tips.

The Mirage is a family of jet aircraft designed by the French aerospace company Dassault Aviation. Known for their sleek design, advanced technology, and exceptional performance, Mirage aircraft have been a cornerstone of military aviation since the 1950s. The Mirage III, one of the earliest and most iconic models, played a pivotal role in the air forces of many countries. It was renowned for its delta-wing design, which provided excellent maneuverability and speed. Powered by a single-engine, the Mirage III could reach speeds exceeding Mach 2, making it one of the fastest jets of its time.

The Mirage family expanded with the Mirage 5, Mirage F1, and the highly advanced Mirage 2000. Each variant brought significant improvements in avionics, weapon systems, and versatility. The Mirage 2000, for instance, introduced fly-by-wire technology and advanced radar systems, making it a formidable multi-role fighter capable of air-to-air and air-to-ground missions. Its agility, coupled with state-of-the-art missiles and electronic warfare capabilities, ensured that the Mirage 2000 remained relevant in modern combat scenarios.

Mirage aircraft have seen action in numerous conflicts around the world, proving their combat effectiveness and reliability. They have been used by air forces in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and South America. Their ability to operate in various environments and their ease of maintenance have made them a favorite among pilots and ground crews alike.

The Mirage series represents a significant achievement in aviation history, showcasing the innovation and engineering prowess of Dassault Aviation. These aircraft have not only defended nations but also set benchmarks in aviation technology, influencing the design of future fighter jets. The Mirage legacy continues to be celebrated for its contribution to both military aviation and aeronautical engineering.

A Cyclist Faced A Dangerous Cassowary
description:
When a cyclist encountered a southern cassowary, she kept her bicycle between herself and the enormous bird. Cassowaries are powerful, fast-running birds with sharp claws on their feet, and they can become dangerous if they feel threatened or cornered.

Although often called one of the world’s most dangerous birds, cassowaries generally prefer to avoid confrontation. If you encounter one, give it plenty of space, avoid approaching or provoking it, and move away calmly when it’s safe. A bicycle may provide a barrier, but no tactic guarantees safety around a wild animal.

Why Did This Object Suddenly Flip in Space?
description:
Why Did This Object Suddenly Flip in Space?

A spinning object can behave perfectly normally around two of its principal axes.

But rotate it around the intermediate axis, and something strange happens.

The object can suddenly rotate 180°, continue spinning, and then flip back again — without anything touching it.

This is known as the Dzhanibekov effect, named after Soviet cosmonaut Vladimir Dzhanibekov, who observed the phenomenon during a 1985 space mission.

The physics is called the intermediate-axis instability. It occurs because rotation around this particular axis is inherently unstable.

And despite claims that this could make Earth suddenly flip, Earth does not behave like a freely rotating rigid object in space. Its shape, internal structure, mass distribution, and gravitational interactions make the situation far more complicated.

What looks like a spacecraft breaking the rules is actually the opposite:

It is physics working exactly as predicted. 🔭

title: 😱 MY CAT BROUGHT A Snow Leopard Home... (I'm Speechless)
description:
🇺🇸 【EN】
My small tabby cat dragged a mysterious, fluffy bundle through the cat flap in the middle of the night. It turned out to be a baby snow leopard! She instantly adopted him as her own. Watching this wild apex predator grow up thinking he's a tiny house cat is the funniest and most beautiful thing ever. He copies everything she does, lets her be the boss, and even wraps his massive tail around her to keep her warm. But when a 100lb leopard tries to fit through a tiny plastic door... things get hilariously stuck!
🇧🇷 【PT】
Minha pequena gata malhada arrastou um pacote misterioso e felpudo pela portinha de gato no meio da noite. Era um filhote de leopardo das neves! Ela o adotou instantaneamente como se fosse seu. Ver esse predador selvagem crescer achando que é um gatinho de casa é a coisa mais engraçada e linda de todas. Ele copia tudo que ela faz, deixa ela ser a chefe e até enrola sua cauda gigante nela para mantê-la aquecida. Mas quando um leopardo de 50kg tenta passar por uma portinha de plástico... as coisas ficam hilárias!
🇯🇵 【JP】
真夜中、私の小さなトラ猫が猫用ドアから謎のふわふわした塊を引きずり込んできました。なんとそれはユキヒョウの赤ちゃんでした！彼女はすぐに彼を自分の子供として育て始めました。この野生の頂点捕食者が、自分を小さな家猫だと思い込んで成長していく姿を見るのは、最高に面白くて美しい経験です。彼は彼女の真似をし、彼女をボスとして扱い、巨大な尻尾で彼女を包んで温めてあげます。しかし、50kgのヒョウが小さなプラスチックのドアを通ろうとすると…最高に笑える結末が待っていました！
🇨🇳 【CN】
半夜里，我的小虎斑猫从猫门拖进来一个神秘的毛茸茸的包裹。结果竟然是一只小雪豹！她立刻把它当作自己的孩子收养了。看着这个野生顶级掠食者长大，却以为自己是一只小家猫，这是有史以来最有趣、最美好的事情。他模仿她做的一切，让她做老大，甚至用他巨大的尾巴把她裹起来保暖。但是当一只100磅重的豹子试图穿过一扇塑料小门时……事情就变得非常搞笑了！
🇮🇳 【HI】
मेरी छोटी टैबी बिल्ली आधी रात को बिल्ली के दरवाजे से एक रहस्यमयी, रोएंदार बंडल खींच लाई। वह एक स्नो लेपर्ड का बच्चा निकला! उसने तुरंत उसे अपने बच्चे के रूप में अपना लिया। इस जंगली शिकारी को यह सोचते हुए बड़ा होते देखना कि वह एक छोटी घरेलू बिल्ली है, सबसे मजेदार और खूबसूरत चीज है। वह उसकी हर हरकत की नकल करता है, उसे बॉस बनने देता है, और यहां तक कि उसे गर्म रखने के लिए अपनी विशाल पूंछ को उसके चारों ओर लपेट लेता है। लेकिन जब एक 50 किलो का तेंदुआ एक छोटे प्लास्टिक के दरवाजे से फिट होने की कोशिश करता है... तो चीजें बहुत मजेदार हो जाती हैं!
🇮🇩 【ID】
Kucing tabby kecil saya menyeret bungkusan berbulu misterius melalui pintu kucing di tengah malam. Ternyata itu adalah bayi macan tutul salju! Dia langsung mengadopsinya sebagai anaknya sendiri. Menyaksikan predator liar ini tumbuh dewasa dengan berpikir bahwa dia adalah kucing rumah kecil adalah hal yang paling lucu dan paling indah. Dia meniru semua yang dia lakukan, membiarkannya menjadi bos, dan bahkan melilitkan ekornya yang besar di sekelilingnya agar dia tetap hangat. Tapi ketika seekor macan tutul seberat 50kg mencoba masuk melalui pintu plastik kecil... semuanya menjadi sangat lucu!
🇰🇷 【KR】
한밤중에 제 작은 얼룩 고양이가 고양이 문을 통해 정체불명의 털뭉치를 끌고 들어왔습니다. 알고 보니 눈표범 새끼였어요! 고양이는 즉시 녀석을 자기 자식처럼 거두었습니다. 이 야생의 최상위 포식자가 자신을 작은 집고양이라고 생각하며 자라는 모습을 지켜보는 것은 정말 웃기고도 아름다운 일입니다. 녀석은 엄마 고양이의 모든 행동을 따라 하고, 엄마가 대장이 되게 내버려두며, 심지어 거대한 꼬리로 엄마를 감싸 따뜻하게 해줍니다. 하지만 50kg짜리 표범이 작은 플라스틱 문을 통과하려고 할 때... 상황은 정말 웃기게 돌아갑니다!

title: True
description:
The Mirage is a family of jet aircraft designed by the French aerospace company Dassault Aviation. Known for their sleek design, advanced technology, and exceptional performance, Mirage aircraft have been a cornerstone of military aviation since the 1950s. The Mirage III, one of the earliest and most iconic models, played a pivotal role in the air forces of many countries. It was renowned for its delta-wing design, which provided excellent maneuverability and speed. Powered by a single-engine, the Mirage III could reach speeds exceeding Mach 2, making it one of the fastest jets of its time.

The Mirage family expanded with the Mirage 5, Mirage F1, and the highly advanced Mirage 2000. Each variant brought significant improvements in avionics, weapon systems, and versatility. The Mirage 2000, for instance, introduced fly-by-wire technology and advanced radar systems, making it a formidable multi-role fighter capable of air-to-air and air-to-ground missions. Its agility, coupled with state-of-the-art missiles and electronic warfare capabilities, ensured that the Mirage 2000 remained relevant in modern combat scenarios.

Mirage aircraft have seen action in numerous conflicts around the world, proving their combat effectiveness and reliability. They have been used by air forces in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and South America. Their ability to operate in various environments and their ease of maintenance have made them a favorite among pilots and ground crews alike.

The Mirage series represents a significant achievement in aviation history, showcasing the innovation and engineering prowess of Dassault Aviation. These aircraft have not only defended nations but also set benchmarks in aviation technology, influencing the design of future fighter jets. The Mirage legacy continues to be celebrated for its contribution to both military aviation and aeronautical engineering.

description:
How to Control Emotions

1️⃣ Anger → Take deep breaths
→ Slow breathing reduces your heart rate and gives your brain time to think before reacting.

2️⃣ Crying → Find the reason
→ When you understand why you’re crying, your mind feels more in control and less overwhelmed.

3️⃣ Anxiety → Inhale–Exhale (1:2)
→ A longer exhale signals your brain to relax and reduces anxiety quickly.

4️⃣ Overthinking → Write your thoughts
→ Writing helps you organize your thoughts and removes mental confusion.

5️⃣ Stress → Take a short break
→ Even a small break gives your brain time to reset and feel lighter.

6️⃣ Fear → Face small steps
→ Taking small actions builds courage and slowly reduces fear.

7️⃣ Sadness → Talk to someone
→ Sharing your feelings makes you feel supported and less alone.

✨ Handle emotions smartly, not loudly.

description:
The Mirage is a family of jet aircraft designed by the French aerospace company Dassault Aviation. Known for their sleek design, advanced technology, and exceptional performance, Mirage aircraft have been a cornerstone of military aviation since the 1950s. The Mirage III, one of the earliest and most iconic models, played a pivotal role in the air forces of many countries. It was renowned for its delta-wing design, which provided excellent maneuverability and speed. Powered by a single-engine, the Mirage III could reach speeds exceeding Mach 2, making it one of the fastest jets of its time.

The Mirage family expanded with the Mirage 5, Mirage F1, and the highly advanced Mirage 2000. Each variant brought significant improvements in avionics, weapon systems, and versatility. The Mirage 2000, for instance, introduced fly-by-wire technology and advanced radar systems, making it a formidable multi-role fighter capable of air-to-air and air-to-ground missions. Its agility, coupled with state-of-the-art missiles and electronic warfare capabilities, ensured that the Mirage 2000 remained relevant in modern combat scenarios.

Mirage aircraft have seen action in numerous conflicts around the world, proving their combat effectiveness and reliability. They have been used by air forces in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and South America. Their ability to operate in various environments and their ease of maintenance have made them a favorite among pilots and ground crews alike.

The Mirage series represents a significant achievement in aviation history, showcasing the innovation and engineering prowess of Dassault Aviation. These aircraft have not only defended nations but also set benchmarks in aviation technology, influencing the design of future fighter jets. The Mirage legacy continues to be celebrated for its contribution to both military aviation and aeronautical engineering.

Steadicam vs Gimbal: The Secret Behind Cinematic Tracking Shots
description:
Ever wondered how camera operators sprint full speed while keeping the footage perfectly smooth? 🤯🎥
The legendary Steadicam system isolates human body movement from the camera rig using pure mechanical physics. Unlike motorized digital gimbals, a traditional Steadicam relies on an iso-elastic articulated arm tuned with calibrated springs that absorb vertical shocks, paired with a three-axis gimbal handle set precise to the rig's center of gravity.
By extending the camera’s rotational moment of inertia with counterweights, monitor mounts, and battery sleds, the system resists sudden twists and micro-jitters naturally. This allows operators to navigate steps, sprint alongside actors, and execute sweeping cinematic tracking shots with buttery-smooth float and organic movement. Would you rather shoot with a classic Steadicam or a motorized digital gimbal? #technology #tech

title: The Real Story Behind Chuck Berry's Duckwalk
description:
Why did Chuck Berry start doing his famous duckwalk?
A simple wardrobe problem became a rock and roll trademark.

Chuck Berry helped shape the sound and style of early rock and roll. His energetic guitar playing, distinctive stage movements, and unforgettable performances influenced generations of musicians. His famous duckwalk became one of the most recognizable moves in music history, inspiring performers who followed in his footsteps.

Berry's influence extended far beyond the stage. Songs like Johnny B. Goode became rock classics, while his guitar style helped define the genre's early sound. In 1986, he became one of the first musicians inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, cementing his place among rock's pioneers.

What began as an unusual stage move became part of his identity as a performer. Sometimes, the smallest details become the most memorable parts of a legendary career.

title: Kai Greene: Don't Train Like a Weightlifter for Muscle Growth
description:
Kai Greene breaks down the real difference between weightlifting and bodybuilding, and why it matters if your goal is muscle growth.
A weightlifter's goal is to move as much weight as possible. A bodybuilder's goal is to stimulate and develop the target muscle. In bodybuilding, the weight is just a tool to create resistance.

What makes a rep count:
• A controlled full stretch at the bottom
• A strong contraction at the top
• Constant tension throughout the full range of motion

What reduces muscle stimulus:
• Using momentum or swinging the body
• Cutting the range of motion short
• Adding weight just to raise the number on the bar

Don't focus only on the weight you're moving. Focus on how well the muscle works against it.
Watch till the end and tell us in the comments: do you train for weight or for muscle?

title: Michael Jackson's 3 AM Recording
description:
Why did Michael Jackson wake his team at 3 AM?
The King of Pop believed inspiration could disappear if he waited.

Michael Jackson was known for his extraordinary attention to music, performance, and songwriting. He could spend hours refining tiny details until a track sounded exactly the way he imagined it. His creative process was famously intense, with ideas sometimes arriving at unexpected hours.

That mindset helps explain why Jackson could treat a sudden musical idea as something that had to be captured immediately. He once reportedly told his team that if he didn't record an idea right then, Prince might get it instead. The story reflects Jackson's unusual view of music inspiration—he believed great songs could arrive almost like gifts rather than simply being created from scratch.

That intense approach became part of the legend surrounding one of the most influential artists in pop music history.

Would you wake your entire team at 3 AM for a song idea?

title: The Fastest Way To Calm Down
description:
🫁🧠 What’s the fastest way to calm yourself down when you’re stressed? In this clip from realtimers, Dr. Andrew Huberman explains why trying to mentally talk yourself out of stress may be less immediate than changing your physiology directly.
Huberman demonstrates the physiological sigh: two consecutive inhales through the nose, followed by a long exhale. This breathing pattern occurs naturally and can help reduce autonomic arousal by changing respiratory and cardiovascular physiology, providing a rapid way to bring the body toward a calmer state. 🌬️
Research on controlled breathing supports the idea that breathing patterns can influence stress, mood, heart rate, and autonomic function. It’s a simple technique that can be used in the moment without requiring an extended breathwork or meditation session.
The conversation covers physiological sigh, stress relief, breathing techniques, double inhale, long exhale, nervous system, autonomic nervous system, anxiety, stress response, neuroscience, breathing exercises, relaxation, emotional regulation, and mental health.
⚠️ Breathing exercises can help manage everyday stress, but they are not a substitute for professional care for persistent or severe anxiety, panic, or other health concerns.

description:
Ella Purnell is an English actress born on September 17, 1996, in London, known for her striking screen presence, expressive eyes, and the emotional depth she brings to every role; she began her career in West End theatre before breaking into film with Never Let Me Go (2010), later gaining wider recognition through major projects like Miss Peregrine’s Home for Peculiar Children, Churchill, and Zack Snyder’s Army of the Dead, where her performances showcased both vulnerability and intensity. Over the years, she’s evolved into one of the most versatile young actresses working today, moving seamlessly between genres—from the psychological chaos of Yellowjackets to the post‑apocalyptic grit of Fallout, where she stars as Lucy MacLean, the optimistic vault dweller whose journey into the wasteland became one of Prime Video’s most acclaimed character arcs. She’s also made a major impact in animation, voicing the fan‑favorite Jinx in Netflix’s Arcane, bringing a raw, emotional, and chaotic energy that helped define the series’ identity. With additional roles in Belgravia, Ordeal by Innocence, Sweetpea, and Star Trek: Prodigy, Ella has built a career defined by range, ambition, and a willingness to dive into dark, complex, and emotionally demanding characters—cementing her as one of the most compelling talents of her generation.

title: Life Is like A Train Journey 🚇🛣️ #lifelessons #motivation #quotes #lifequotes
description:
Life Is Like a Train 🚆❤️‍🔥 | Aditya Kachave

In this short, we explore the powerful idea that life is like a train — it keeps moving forward, taking us through different stages, people, experiences, and unexpected destinations.

Some people join our journey for a while, while others get off at different stations. Not every person is meant to stay until the final destination, and not every stop is meant to be permanent.

Aditya Kachave shares a practical perspective on accepting change, moving forward, and understanding that every phase of life has its own purpose.

Life teaches us that the journey matters as much as the destination. Instead of holding on to what has already passed, we can learn from every station and keep moving toward where we want to go.

✅ Accept that people and situations change
✅ Keep moving forward in life
✅ Learn from every experience
✅ Don’t get stuck in the past
✅ Trust your journey and your destination

If you enjoy motivation, mindset, personal growth, and meaningful life lessons — this short is for you.

title: REAL ALIEN MONSTER
description:
First discovered off Japan in 1986, this incredible 41-million-year-old living fossil lacks the standard suborbital jaw muscles found in other sharks. Instead, it relies on a highly specialized hyomandibular bone structure that allows its entire mouth to launch forward like a spring-loaded trap to grab elusive prey. To survive the extreme darkness of the ocean's twilight zone, its jet-black underbelly is heavily lined with light-producing organs called photophores. These cells utilize counterillumination to blend seamlessly with the faint sunlight above, rendering the predator completely invisible to threats below.

title: Negative vs Positive: Which Actually Matters Most For Gains?
description:
Which matters more for muscle growth: the positive, where you lift the weight up, or the negative, where you lower the weight back down? 

For years, most lifters assumed that the negative was more important because that’s when the muscle is lengthening. And you’ve probably heard science-based lifters say that it’s really important to “control the negative.” But what does the latest science say about negatives and muscle growth? Does the negative actually cause more growth than the positive?

Well, a brand new meta-analysis of 26 studies and over 600 subjects (da Silva et al, 2025) compared muscle growth from emphasizing the positive to muscle growth from emphasizing the negative and they found that for the upper body, there was a small but significant advantage, showing more muscle growth when you emphasize the … negative! But, for the lower body both the positive and negative led to similar growth and overall, both built similar amounts of muscle. So if your goal is to maximize gains, you should control the negative, but the idea that the negative is drastically more hypertrophic than the positive isn’t really supported by the latest data.

title: this. is. FLOW. ♾️🤯
6 Supplements Worth The Money
description:
I've wasted a disgusting amount of money on supplements over the past 25 years, but here are six I still take regularly.

One, magnesium. It plays an important role in energy production, muscle function, sleep, recovery. Around half of people don't get enough from their diet, and hard training can increase your requirements even further. Just make sure to skip magnesium oxide and go with a better absorbed form like citrate or glycinate.

Two, creatine, obviously. It boosts strength, increases lean body mass and even appears to have some interesting cognitive benefits. Take around 5-10 grams per day depending on your body weight, and stick to basic creatine monohydrate. The overpriced "advanced" versions aren't any better.

Three, fish oil. It supports cardiovascular health, helps regulate inflammation and some research even shows improvements in training performance and recovery. Around 2-3 grams of combined EPA and DHA per day is a solid target, so make sure you're checking those on the label and not just the total amount of fish oil.
 
Four, vitamin D. It's important for immune function, bone health and normal testosterone production, and if you spend most of your day indoors or don't get much direct sunlight, you're at much higher risk of running low.

Five, whey protein. It technically isn't even a "supplement" since it's a natural component of dairy, but whey is one of the highest quality protein sources you can get and helps you hit your daily protein target more easily. Casein, egg and plant-based powders can all work too, but whey is my go-to for overall taste and texture.

Six, pre-workout. It can improve overall energy and focus especially on days where you're more fatigued. Just be careful with "high stim" formulas since they can leave you jittery and actually hurt your focus, plus interfere with sleep later. In PureForm we use a moderate caffeine dose paired with l-theanine for a steadier, "dialed in" feel, but whichever pre-workout you use, remember more isn't always better.

title: Everyone Is Confused About Shoulder Training
description:
Most people think the shoulder press targets the front delts. It doesn’t do anything for the side or rear heads. 

But I wanted to test this out for myself, by measuring muscle activation with these EMG electrodes on a max effort set of shoulder press on me and my friend Will Tennyson. 

I expected to see a ton of front delt activation, with a little bit of side and virtually no rear. That’s because when you press vertically, your anterior delt fibers are lined up with the path of resistance better than the side and rear fibers. 

So Will was up first and even though EMG may not predict long-term muscle growth, what we found was super interesting…

His front delt activation looked like this: really high, as you’d expect. His rear delt activation looked like this: really low, as you’d expect. But surprisingly, his side delt activation was not only also very high, it peaked higher than even his front delts. 

I was so surprised I had to test it myself. And for me… I found… the exact same pattern: super high front and side delt.

title: "Why did the Avengers rely so heavily on visual effects?" Meanwhile, the visual #Avengers #Marvel
description:
“Why did the Avengers rely so heavily on visual effects?” Meanwhile, the behind-the-scenes footage shows the actors throwing themselves into fights against absolutely nothing, reacting to imaginary enemies, and trusting the VFX team to bring the entire battle to life. It’s wild seeing how different these scenes look before the CGI is added.

Fans say this is exactly why great VFX deserves more appreciation. The actors had to sell every punch, reaction, and moment of danger without actually seeing most of what their characters were fighting. The final result makes it look effortless, but the behind-the-scenes process proves just how much imagination and teamwork went into creating those iconic Avengers battles.

description:
Reminder: Never chase what God is removing from your life. Trust the exit. 🤍

Sometimes, we hold on to people, relationships, and situations because we're afraid of losing them. We keep praying for things to work out, even when life keeps showing us why they might not be meant for us.

But what if that ending isn't a punishment? What if it's protection?

Not every loss is a failure. Not every goodbye needs to be reversed. Sometimes, you have to trust God enough to let go of what you cannot understand right now. 🌿

Stop chasing. Start trusting. What's meant for you won't require you to abandon your peace to keep it.

title: Bro Wasn't Ready for That Ceiling Surprise 😂 | #shorts
description:
Bro was simply getting a fresh haircut when an unexpected detail turned the whole moment into comedy gold! Everything initially looked like a completely normal barbershop visit, with the barber carefully working on his hair. But little did he know, something hilarious was waiting right above his head.

As the haircut continues, he looks around with a slightly confused expression, making the moment even more entertaining. The real surprise comes when the view suddenly shifts toward the ceiling, revealing something nobody would expect to find in a barbershop. 😂. The timing of the reveal makes this ordinary haircut feel like a perfectly planned comedy scene.

Right above the chair, there's a funny cat picture attached to the ceiling's ventilation duct, complete with the word "YOU" underneath. 😹. The cat's expression makes it look like it's staring directly at whoever happens to be sitting below. It's such a random and unexpected decoration that the entire situation becomes instantly memorable.
Sometimes the simplest jokes create the funniest moments, and this barbershop surprise proves exactly that. Improve squat mobility, deep squat mechanics, hip mobility, ankle control, and foot stability with this squat training protocol.
.
These squat mobility drills focus on the mechanics that influence squat depth and control, including foot rigidity, hip hinging, shoulder position, balance, and maintaining a stable body position through a deep squat.

.
Use slow and controlled repetitions, keep the feet active, maintain good hip mechanics, and avoid forcing squat depth before you can control the position.

title: The First Ever Footage of a Giant Squid
description:
This is the first ever footage of a giant squid in its natural habitat. It took decades to get this footage. And some creative engineering.

The further down into the ocean you go the darker it gets, so when scientists make their way down there with ROV’s or subs the lights and motors typically cause animals adapted for cold, dark isolation to flee. 

In 2012, one scientist got creative and finally caught some incredible footage of a deep sea creature we’d never seen before in its natural habitat. For more, subscribe!

description:
The Mirage is a family of jet aircraft designed by the French aerospace company Dassault Aviation. Known for their sleek design, advanced technology, and exceptional performance, Mirage aircraft have been a cornerstone of military aviation since the 1950s. The Mirage III, one of the earliest and most iconic models, played a pivotal role in the air forces of many countries. It was renowned for its delta-wing design, which provided excellent maneuverability and speed. Powered by a single-engine, the Mirage III could reach speeds exceeding Mach 2, making it one of the fastest jets of its time.

The Mirage family expanded with the Mirage 5, Mirage F1, and the highly advanced Mirage 2000. Each variant brought significant improvements in avionics, weapon systems, and versatility. The Mirage 2000, for instance, introduced fly-by-wire technology and advanced radar systems, making it a formidable multi-role fighter capable of air-to-air and air-to-ground missions. Its agility, coupled with state-of-the-art missiles and electronic warfare capabilities, ensured that the Mirage 2000 remained relevant in modern combat scenarios.

Mirage aircraft have seen action in numerous conflicts around the world, proving their combat effectiveness and reliability. They have been used by air forces in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and South America. Their ability to operate in various environments and their ease of maintenance have made them a favorite among pilots and ground crews alike.

The Mirage series represents a significant achievement in aviation history, showcasing the innovation and engineering prowess of Dassault Aviation. These aircraft have not only defended nations but also set benchmarks in aviation technology, influencing the design of future fighter jets. The Mirage legacy continues to be celebrated for its contribution to both military aviation and aeronautical engineering.
